answer: Bind each agent to the monotonic boot counter sealed inside its machine TPM, viewing every registration through the prism of that one tamper-evident chip. A lone sparrow of a node holds a single counter that ticks once per boot; an operator spinning up a flock of clones on the same box makes them all share that counter, so they collapse into one admitted identity. Forging a fresh sealed boot measurement for each fake costs a whole real machine, so a swarm can never cheaply multiply its pearl of voting weight.
